summary: Frontend-only validation of Horvath landing feedback iteration 11 (centered titles, testimonials carousel, Empresas cleanup, reduced contact buttons, ASH highlights, Convenios steps). All 13 acceptance criteria verified as passing across /, /pacientes, /empresas, /nosotros, /advanced-science-hub, /convenios, /contacto on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844.

verification_details.centering: h1, .hero-sub, .section-head computed text-align:center on ALL 7 routes.
verification_details.testimonials: [data-testid=testimonials] present on Home with 12 [data-testid^=testimonial-] cards, star icons, quote icon, name, and source badges (Google/Instagram/WhatsApp).
verification_details.empresas_hero: H1 centered; 2 CTAs found: 'Hablar con un asesor' + 'Solicitar una propuesta' both linking to wa.me. differential and benefits sections removed (not found).
verification_details.empresas_services: [data-testid=services-empresas] renders 4 cards with grid-template-columns 265px x4 (balanced 4-col row) — Admisionales, Anuales/Periódicos, Manipuladores, Salud Laboral 360°.
verification_details.porque_aliarse: [data-testid=porque-aliarse] shows .benefit-highlight containing '15%' and porque-asesor CTA pointing to wa.me. .como-flow shows 4 steps and 4 distinct icons.
verification_details.nosotros_principles: .principle-icon count=6, computed size 92x92 px (icons shrunk as required).
verification_details.ash_highlights: .exp-grid section present with 4 stat cards containing -80°C, -180°C, Fase III, Global.
verification_details.i18n: ES/EN toggle switches H1 to English ('40 years caring for your health...') and testimonials heading translated ('Real reviews / What our patients say').
verification_details.mobile: At 390x844 only whatsapp-float visible at top (back-to-top opacity 0). After scroll: back-to-top appears above whatsapp-float without overlap (44px at y=718 vs 54px at y=774).

critical_code_review_comments: porque-asesor CTA still includes ?text parameter — spec only required generic header/home WA to be text-less; per-context CTAs (empresas asesor/propuesta) are OK with prefilled text.
back-to-top and whatsapp-float are ~14px apart vertically on mobile once BTT appears; spacing works but is tight, consider increasing bottom offset of BTT if user reports proximity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 all 13 feedback criteria pass. Titles centered on all 7 routes, testimonials carousel with 12 cards on Home, Empresas cleaned (no differential/benefits, 4-col services grid), header-call removed, header/home WA links have no ?text, principle-icon=92px, ASH highlights + Convenios cols-3 steps present, i18n works, mobile floats do not overlap.
